pr_title: Fix: Fixed issue where soft link details were misaligned in git repos
pr_body:
- Closes #15998

**Steps used to test these changes**

Stability is a top priority for Files and all changes are required to go through testing before being merged into the repo. Please include a list of steps that you used to test this PR.

1. Opened Files ...
2. Create a link in git repo.
3. Change to detail view.
4. Check the alignment.

issue_context.title: Bug: Soft link file details layout information misaligned
issue_context.body:
### Description

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/76638fee-dcdf-446f-b5be-3e6fa6a013fa)


### Steps To Reproduce

1. create a softlink file (via mklink, not a Windows shortcut file) under a git project
2. switch to `Details` layout

### Requirements

soft link file has the same alignment with other files

### Files Version

3.6.0.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22631.3958

### Log File

no
comments: Thanks for the report, I reproduced this issue and have added this to the project board.
I could not able to see any missalignment of detail of the sortcut created by mklink in git repos.
I am a beginner and this is my first time i'm here, it will be very helpful for me if someone let me know, how can i make contributions to the open source.

1. Build the project referencing the instructions described [here](https://files.community/docs/contributing/building-from-source)
2. [Enumerated items are converted](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/src/Files.App/Utils/Storage/Enumerators/Win32StorageEnumerator.cs#L280) into `ListedItem` derivative classes such as GitItem and ShortcutItem
3. I guess [IsGitItem](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/src/Files.App/Data/Items/ListedItem.cs#L414) is false while should be true as [checking if item is git one](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/src/Files.App/Utils/Storage/Enumerators/Win32StorageEnumerator.cs#L364) is done after [checking if item is shortcut one](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/src/Files.App/Utils/Storage/Enumerators/Win32StorageEnumerator.cs#L276).
4. So [if (isGitRepo) {}](https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/main/src/Files.App/Utils/Storage/Enumerators/Win32StorageEnumerator.cs#L362) should be the first checking

The actual UI code that displays git info (as you can see IsGitItem handles if the element should be x:Load'ed):
https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/8fe155cd2376e5029675b04a0dd11c0b1db2963e/src/Files.App/Views/Layouts/DetailsLayoutPage.xaml#L1019-L1089

If you have questions, let me know!
Based on my testing, I was unable to reproduce the issue. It is possible that this problem has already been fixed in a recent update.
I can still reproduce this, Make sure you following the steps to reproduce when testing

Apologies, you're right—I didn't simulate the exact issue. Now I can clearly see the problem, and I'm going to resolve it.

Could you please assign this issue to me?
